ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What stage of development does a mosquito go through after the egg stage?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image is a schematic diagram of the mosquito life cycle: in the upper circle is an adult mosquito, and in the right-side circle is a cluster of many small round granular objects, representing eggs; from the image of the eggs on the right side, following the gray arrow downward, it points to the aquatic, slender, curved larval form in the lower circle. The question asks what developmental stage the mosquito experiences after the egg stage. According to the arrow from eggs to the next stage in the figure, after eggs is the larval form, therefore the answer is the larval stage.
